surfaces.description: Filter and explore anime and manga titles from MyAnimeList with advanced search, statistics, schedules, and watchlists.
Filter anime by score, year, genres, themes, demographics, popularity, status, and format with shareable search URLs.
Pick a random anime from the public Anime List catalog and narrow the choice with the same discovery filters used by search.
Explore anime score distributions, formats, years, genres, themes, demographics, popularity, and catalog coverage.
Search and filter more than 20,000 manga titles by score, year, genres, themes, demographics, status, and format.
Explore manga score distributions, formats, years, genres, themes, demographics, popularity, and catalog coverage.
Verified product releases for Anime List, including anime and manga discovery, watchlists, schedules, and catalog improvements.
Review daily anime and manga catalog ingestion history, update timing, and the latest public dataset refreshes.
Learn how Anime List combines MyAnimeList catalog data, advanced filtering, smart ranking, statistics, and personal tracking.
Understand Anime List account data, Google sign-in, watchlist storage, and product analytics.
Terms for using Anime List catalog discovery, personal watchlists, and MyAnimeList-derived metadata.
Connect agents to Anime List public catalog tools and manage a personal access token for authenticated watchlist tools.

mcp.authentication: Public catalog tools are open; private watchlist tools require a personal access token.
